finding.message: The table of contents is out of date: entry 2 is "Setup" but the heading is "Installation". A reader who follows it can land in the wrong place.
finding.how_to_fix: In Word, click in the table of contents and choose Update Table, then Update entire table (or press F9). Adapdf can also update the fields when it exports the PDF.

description: Update the table of contents and other fields. Word does this when the PDF is exported.
